name: dialog-unsaved-changes
title: Dialog unsaved changes
description: A dialog that only closes through its buttons, so a click outside doesn't lose the user's changes.

files.content:
import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { Button } from '@/ui/button/button'; import { DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogOverlay, DialogTitle, Dialog, DialogClose, DialogPortal, DialogTrigger, } from '@/ui/dialog/dialog'; import { Label } from '@/ui/label/label'; import { Textarea } from '@/ui/textarea/textarea'; /** * A dialog that a click outside doesn't close, so the user doesn't lose * what they typed by accident. Escape and the buttons still close it. */ @Component({ selector: 'example-dialog-unsaved-changes', imports: [ Button, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogOverlay, DialogTitle, Label, Dialog, DialogClose, DialogPortal, DialogTrigger, Textarea, ], template: `

New note

The note is kept until you save or discard it.

`, }) export class DialogUnsavedChangesExample {}
